children: Wynn Al Marjan Island has unveiled two ultra-luxury accommodations, the Mayfair Apartment and Paris Apartment, positioned as the largest and highest residences within Enclave, the resort’s boutique hotel concept.
Located on the uppermost floors of the 70-storey Resort Tower, each apartment spans approximately 1,460 square metres and offers panoramic views of the Hajar Mountains and Arabian Gulf.
The residences are designed around privacy, personalised service and bespoke interiors, with seven bedrooms, multiple entertaining areas, private bars and dedicated in-apartment services.

The apartments were created through a collaboration between Todd-Avery Lenahan, President and Chief Creative Officer of Wynn Design & Development, and London-based Anouska Hempel Design and Paris studio Pinto.

"I have long admired these two studios because both Pinto and Anouska Hempel are the originators of unique genres of design in our industry," says Todd-Avery Lenahan. "I sought to commission the ateliers that did it first — the studios that established many of the design principles still referenced throughout the highest levels of luxury design for decades. In an industry that can be so trend-driven and disposable, I wanted to create something rooted in the legacy of knowing what captivates people universally yet is entirely relevant to the most discerning contemporary guest."
The Paris Apartment, designed by Pinto, draws inspiration from the home of a 21st-century collector and global traveller.
The two-storey residence combines bespoke furnishings, curated artworks and objects sourced from around the world.
Grand columns, glass surfaces, hand-painted murals and artisan lighting create a distinctive interpretation of contemporary Arabic hospitality.

"The space is composed of a mix of bespoke pieces, auction finds, and market discoveries — and that mix makes it a traveller’s space," says Pietro Scaglione, co-artistic director of Pinto. "It is a dialogue of different ages and cultures. The challenge was for it to feel exclusive yet still feel like home."
The Mayfair Apartment, designed by Anouska Hempel Design, takes inspiration from London’s grand private residences.
Classical planning, rich materials and detailed craftsmanship are combined with jewel-toned green interiors, green marble, lacquered panelling and gilded accents.
Both apartments are designed to provide a fully private experience, with dining, spa and salon treatments, entertainment and personalised services delivered within the residences.

"The Mayfair and Paris Apartments are palaces in the sky. There is nothing on the world stage today that will rival what we’ve created here." says Lenahan. "Everything comes to you. There are only two accommodations at this level of the tower, and every aspect of the experience has been intentionally designed around privacy, service, and personalisation."

The apartments form part of Enclave, which comprises 313 suites across three accommodation categories: The Mayfair and Paris Apartments, Townhomes, and Marina and Ocean Estates. Enclave features a private entrance, dedicated lobby and elevators, with no more than nine suites on each floor.
